title: Intelligent Agents
blurb: Rational agents, PEAS, environment properties and the four agent architectures.

title: Problem Solving by Search
blurb: States, actions, result(), goal test, path cost. Search trees vs state spaces, tree vs graph search.

title: Uninformed Search
blurb: BFS, uniform-cost, DFS, depth-limited, iterative deepening, bidirectional. Completeness, optimality, complexity.

title: Informed Search
blurb: Greedy best-first, A*, admissible and consistent heuristics, dominance, relaxed problems, weighted A*, IDA*.

title: Constraint Satisfaction Problems
blurb: Factored states, backtracking, forward checking, arc consistency (AC-3), MRV / degree / LCV, problem structure.

title: Local Search & Optimization
blurb: Hill climbing, local maxima and plateaus, CSPs as optimization (min-conflicts).

title: Adversarial Search
blurb: Games as search, minimax, alpha-beta pruning, move ordering, evaluation functions, expectiminimax.

title: Monte Carlo Tree Search & Bandits
blurb: Rollouts, selection/expansion/simulation/backpropagation, k-armed bandits, ε-greedy, UCB1, UCT, AlphaZero.

title: Learning to Search and Play
blurb: Learning agents, rewards and discounting, value functions and the Bellman equation, ε-greedy, Q-learning, search vs RL, Q-learning vs minimax.

title: Logical Agents & Propositional Logic
blurb: Knowledge bases, entailment and models, CNF, resolution and its strategies, Horn clauses, forward/backward chaining, DPLL, WalkSAT; a glimpse of first-order logic.

title: Classical Planning
blurb: STRIPS and PDDL, action schemas vs ground actions, forward (progression) and backward (regression) planning, relevant and consistent actions, planning heuristics, SATPlan.

title: Uncertainty & Bayesian Networks
blurb: Degrees of belief, marginalization, Bayes' rule, independence; Bayesian networks: chain rule, node ordering, active trails and d-separation, inference by enumeration.
